# Banishwor Athokpam — Mobile Applications & Developer Hub (llms.txt)

> Official developer portfolio, application registry, and personal operating system context for **Banishwor Athokpam** (also known as **Bani** or **Bani Athokpam**). Software engineer specializing in native Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB), offline-first architectures, cultural informatics, and published author from Thoubal, Manipur, India (ꯀꯪꯂꯩꯄꯥꯛ).

## Active Production Applications

### 1. Manipur Calculator
A specialized dual-purpose financial and regional conversion utility engineered for Manipur.
- **Features**: Combines standard arithmetic and financial calculators (Loan EMI, Simple & Compound Interest) with traditional Manipuri land unit converters (Pari, Lourak, Sangam) and Indian gold weight converters (Tola, San, Chaning).
- **Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, BigDecimal (zero floating-point errors), and 100% offline Room database.
- **Link**: https://banishwor.github.io/#manipur-calculator

### 2. Manipuri Calendar (Android & Progressive Web App)
Comprehensive dual-calendar system bridging traditional Meitei chronology with the modern Gregorian calendar.
- **Features**: 200+ Manipuri festivals, Meitei Mayek numeral display, Tatnaba and Thasi Maikei astrological indicators, moon phases, daily horoscopes, and customizable Android home screen widgets. 100% free and ad-free.
- **Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, React 19, TypeScript, WorkManager.
- **Android App**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.manipurcalendar
- **PWA Live**: https://banishwor.github.io/manipuri-calendar-pwa/

### 3. Yek Salai
Cultural preservation mobile app for the Meitei community in Manipur.
- **Features**: Complete database of 860+ Meitei surnames categorized across the 7 sacred clans (Salais). Provides instantaneous marriage compatibility verification adhering to sacred customary laws (Yek Tinnaba, Shairuk Tinnaba).
- **Stack**: React Native, Firebase Remote Config.
- **Link**: https://banishwor.github.io/#yek-salai

### 4. Khutsuman (ꯈꯨꯠꯁꯨꯃꯟ)
Digital wage, attendance, and Hisab ledger manager for construction site supervisors, petty contractors (*Mohoriks*), master carpenters, and tradesmen.
- **Features**: 100% offline attendance tracking (Present, Half-Day, Overtime, Absent), dispute-free itemized settlement calculation, multi-site job grouping, and instant WhatsApp-ready vector PDF report exports.
- **Status**: Beta — Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material Design 3, Encrypted Room Database.
- **Link**: https://banishwor.github.io/#khutsuman

## R&D, Experimental & Archived Projects

### 1. LeikaiFix
Civic grievance redressal and community issue reporting progressive web app.
- **Features**: Geotagged reporting for local road damage, water supply, and streetlights with club/leikai administrative escalation workflows.
- **Stack**: React, TypeScript, Geolocation API, Cloudflare Workers.

### 2. On-Device AI Keyboard (FlorisBoard Meitei Mayek IME)
Native Android IME keyboard layout supporting all 35 characters of the authentic Meitei Mayek script, Cheikhei punctuation, and phonetic sub-character modifiers.

### 3. Viral Prompts Generator
Open-source curated library containing 50+ optimized prompt templates for LLMs, Claude, and Midjourney with instant variable injection.
